facts.zh: 大喬木，高 15–25 米，樹冠寬大
5 月至 12 月
森林。亦廣泛栽培。

items.en: Large tree, 15–25 m, with an ample crown.
items.zh: 大喬木，高 15–25 米，樹冠寬大。

items.en: Deep grey.
items.zh: 深灰色。

items.en: Branches often bear pendulous aerial roots.
items.zh: 枝上常有下垂氣根。

items.en: Leathery; elliptic, ovate-elliptic or obovate. Base cuneate. Apex bluntly apiculate. Margin entire.
items.zh: 革質；橢圓形、卵狀橢圓形或倒卵形。基部楔形。先端鈍而具短尖。全緣。

items.en: Blade 4–8 × 3–4 cm. Petiole stout, 5–10 mm, glabrous.
items.zh: 葉片 4–8 × 3–4 厘米。葉柄粗，5–10 毫米，無毛。

items.en: Basal veins 3. Lateral veins 3–10 pairs.
items.zh: 基出脈 3 條。側脈 3–10 對。

items.en: Yellowish or reddish, paired or solitary in the leaf axils, obovoid, 6–8 mm, without peduncles. Basal bracts 3.
items.zh: 黃或紅色，成對或單生於葉腋，倒卵形，6–8 毫米，無花序柄。基部苞片 3。

ecology.en: Native. Common in Hong Kong, and also widely cultivated.
ecology.zh: 原生。香港常見，亦廣泛栽培。

ecology.en: Southwest, south to southeast China; south and southeast Asia to Australia.
ecology.zh: 中國西南、南至東南；南亞及東南亞至澳洲。

photos.en: Park tree with a curtain of pendulous aerial roots.
photos.zh: 公園大樹，下垂氣根成簾。

photos.en: Deep grey bark and a column of aerial roots.
Leathery leaves and sessile axillary figs.
photos.zh: 革質葉，無柄的腋生隱頭花序。

photos.en: Cuneate bases and bluntly apiculate tips.
photos.zh: 楔形葉基，先端鈍而具短尖。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

55052.authority: Sheue, H. Y. Liu & J. Yong

facts.zh: 小喬木，高可達 3 米
全年
紅樹林沼澤邊緣。

items.en: Small tree to 3 m. Bark smooth, reddish brown.
items.zh: 小喬木，高可達 3 米。樹皮平滑，紅褐色。

items.en: Oblong to obovate-oblong. Base broadly cuneate. Apex rounded or obtuse. Veins inconspicuous.
items.zh: 長圓形至倒卵狀長圓形。基部闊楔形。先端圓或鈍。葉脈不明顯。

items.en: Petiole 1–1.8 cm. Blade 5–10 × 2.5–4 cm.
Sepals white, lanceolate, 1.2–1.6 cm, reflexed in fruit. Petals white, bifid.
items.zh: 萼片白色，披針形，1.2–1.6 厘米，結果時反折。花瓣白色，二裂。

items.en: Ovoid, 1.0–1.5 cm, with persistent reflexed sepals.
items.zh: 卵形，1.0–1.5 厘米，宿存反折的萼片。

items.en: Viviparous, 12–20 cm, acuminate at the apex.
items.zh: 胎生，長 12–20 厘米，先端漸尖。

photos.en: Flowering tree at the edge of flooded mangrove.
photos.zh: 水淹紅樹林邊緣的開花植株。

photos.en: Oblong leaf with a rounded apex.

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 灌木，高 1.5–3 米
全年。高峰通常在 8 月至 10 月。

facts.en: Disturbed forests, streamsides, thickets on low hills, roadsides.
facts.zh: 受干擾的森林、溪邊、低丘灌叢、路旁。

items.en: Shrub, 1.5–3 m tall.
Stems, branches, petioles and pedicels densely covered with spreading bristles up to 8 mm.
items.zh: 莖、枝、葉柄和花梗密被開展的刺毛，長可達 8 毫米。

items.en: Opposite. Lanceolate to elliptic-lanceolate. Base obtuse to rounded. Apex acuminate. Margin entire. Strigose on both surfaces.
items.zh: 對生。披針形至橢圓狀披針形。基部鈍至圓。先端漸尖。全緣。兩面被糙伏毛。

items.en: Five-nerved: midvein plus two pairs of lateral primary veins.
items.zh: 5 條基出脈：中脈加兩對側生主脈。

items.en: Terminal, usually 5-merous, solitary or 3–5 in cymes. Petals purple, broadly obovate, apex emarginate.
items.zh: 頂生，通常 5 數，單生或 3–5 朵組成聚傘花序。花瓣紫色，闊倒卵形，先端微凹。

items.en: 10, rarely 8 or 12, dimorphic.
items.zh: 10 枚，罕為 8 或 12，二型。

items.en: Calyx tube 1–2 cm, densely covered with spreading red bristles.
items.zh: 萼管長 1–2 厘米，密被開展的紅色刺毛。

items.en: Fleshy capsule, 1.5–2.2 × 1.5–2 cm, dehiscing irregularly at maturity.
items.zh: 肉質蒴果，1.5–2.2 × 1.5–2 厘米，成熟時不規則開裂。

ecology.en: Disturbed forests, streamsides, thickets on low hills, roadsides.
ecology.zh: 受干擾的森林、溪邊、低丘灌叢、路旁。

ecology.en: Long spreading bristles on the stem and hypanthium, not the appressed scales of Melastoma malabathricum.
ecology.zh: 莖和花被管具長而開展的刺毛，不是野牡丹那種貼伏的鱗片。

photos.en: Erect shrub on a trail, among ferns.
photos.zh: 小徑上的直立灌木，生於芒萁之間。

photos.en: Five purple petals and dimorphic stamens.
photos.zh: 五片紫色花瓣，雄蕊二型。

photos.en: Young fruits with long spreading bristles.
photos.zh: 幼果，具長而開展的刺毛。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Tree to 45 m; bark red-brown, irregularly scaly
facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 45 米；樹皮紅褐色，不規則鱗片狀

facts.en: Pollinating April–May. Seed maturing October–December of the second year.
facts.zh: 傳粉期 4 月至 5 月。種子於翌年 10 月至 12 月成熟。

facts.en: On hills. Also widely planted in the countryside.
facts.zh: 丘陵。亦廣泛植於郊野。

items.en: Tree to 45 m. Crown broadly pyramidal or umbrella-like. Bark red-brown, irregularly scaly and flaking.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 45 米。樹冠闊金字塔形或傘形。樹皮紅褐色，不規則鱗片狀並剝落。

items.en: 2 per bundle, rarely 3. Slender, slightly twisted, 10–18 cm, with a persistent sheath.
items.zh: 每束 2 枚，稀 3 枚。細長，微扭曲，長 10–18 厘米，基部具宿存葉鞘。

items.en: Pendulous, ovoid to ovoid-cylindric, 4–7 × 2.5–5 cm, chestnut brown at maturity.
items.zh: 下垂，卵形至卵狀圓柱形，4–7 × 2.5–5 厘米，成熟時栗褐色。

ecology.en: Native. Common in Hong Kong, and also widely planted in the countryside.
ecology.zh: 原生。香港常見，亦廣泛植於郊野。

ecology.en: Areas south of the Changjiang River.

photos.en: Hillside tree with a red-brown trunk.
photos.zh: 丘陵上的樹，樹幹紅褐色。

photos.en: Two slender needles in a bundle, and brown winter buds.
photos.zh: 每束兩枚細長針葉，冬芽褐色。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 喬木或小喬木
花期 6 月至 8 月。果期 10 月至 12 月。
森林。

items.en: Tree or small tree. Branches greyish brown or reddish brown, glabrescent.
items.zh: 喬木或小喬木。小枝灰褐或紅褐色，漸變無毛。

items.en: Elliptic to oblong-elliptic, 7–13 × 3–6 cm. Base cuneate. Apex acuminate. Margin crenulate to crenulate-serrate.
items.zh: 橢圓形至長圓狀橢圓形，7–13 × 3–6 厘米。基部楔形。先端漸尖。邊緣具圓齒至圓齒狀鋸齒。

items.en: White, 2–3 cm, in short terminal racemes. Petals 5, obovate.
items.zh: 白色，直徑 2–3 厘米，排成短的頂生總狀花序。花瓣 5，倒卵形。

items.en: Subglobose, 1–1.5 cm.
items.zh: 近球形，直徑 1–1.5 厘米。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Hunan, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Fujian, Taiwan.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、湖南、江西、浙江、福建、台灣。

photos.en: Leaf with a crenulate margin and cuneate base.

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Evergreen shrub or tree, up to 10 m
facts.zh: 常綠灌木或喬木，高可達 10 米

facts.en: Flowering August–September. Fruiting December–February of the following year.
facts.zh: 花期 8 月至 9 月。果期 12 月至翌年 2 月。
森林。

items.en: Evergreen shrub or tree, up to 10 m. Young parts tawny tomentose, later glabrescent.
items.zh: 常綠灌木或喬木，高可達 10 米。幼時黃褐色絨毛，後漸無毛。

items.en: Digitately compound, generally 6–8-foliolate. Leaflets elliptic or ovate-elliptic, 7–17 × 3–7.5 cm, margin entire.
items.zh: 掌狀複葉，通常 6–8 小葉。小葉橢圓形或卵狀橢圓形，7–17 × 3–7.5 厘米，全緣。

items.en: Many-flowered umbels in a large terminal panicle. Petals 5.
items.zh: 多花的傘形花序組成大型頂生圓錐花序。花瓣 5。

items.en: Globose, 3–4 mm.
items.zh: 球形，直徑 3–4 毫米。

ecology.en: Southern China to Japan, the Philippines, Vietnam and India.
ecology.zh: 華南至日本、菲律賓、越南及印度。

photos.zh: 圓錐花序上的乳白色傘形花序。
傘形果序上的綠色球形果。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 灌木，高 1–2 米

facts.en: Flowering April–May. Fruiting late summer to early autumn.
facts.zh: 花期 4 月至 5 月。果期夏末至秋初。
灌叢。

items.en: Shrub, 1–2 m. Young branchlets greyish pubescent.
items.zh: 灌木，高 1–2 米。幼枝灰色短柔毛。

items.en: Leathery, elliptic to obovate, 3–8 × 1–4 cm. Grey tomentose abaxially. Reticulate veins conspicuous.
items.zh: 革質，橢圓形至倒卵形，3–8 × 1–4 厘米。背面灰色絨毛。網脈明顯。

items.en: Purplish red, 2–4 cm. Petals 5. Stamens red, 7–8 mm.
items.zh: 紫紅色，直徑 2–4 厘米。花瓣 5。雄蕊紅色，長 7–8 毫米。

items.en: Purplish black when mature, urceolate, 1.5–2 × 1–1.5 cm.
items.zh: 成熟時紫黑色，壇狀，1.5–2 × 1–1.5 厘米。

ecology.en: Southern China to India, Southeast Asia and the Ryukyu Islands.
ecology.zh: 華南至印度、東南亞及琉球群島。

photos.en: Flowering shrubs on a grassy ridge.
Five magenta petals and red stamens.
photos.zh: 五枚洋紅色花瓣，雄蕊紅色。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 大型木質藤本
花期 4 月至 6 月。果期 6 月至 11 月。
森林。

items.en: Large woody climber. Leaves pinnately 3-foliolate.
items.zh: 大型木質藤本。羽狀三出複葉。

items.en: Terminal leaflet elliptic, ovate or somewhat obovate, 3–16 × 2–6 cm, apex caudate-acuminate.
items.zh: 頂生小葉橢圓形、卵形或略倒卵形，3–16 × 2–6 厘米，先端尾狀漸尖。

items.en: Axillary or on old branches, 20–38 cm. Corolla greyish white. Keel 7.5–8.7 cm.
items.zh: 腋生或生於老枝，長 20–38 厘米。花冠灰白色。龍骨瓣長 7.5–8.7 厘米。

items.en: Loriform, 30–45 × 3.5–4 cm, densely rusty-pubescent, slightly constricted between the seeds.
items.zh: 條形，30–45 × 3.5–4 厘米，密被銹色短柔毛，種子間微縊縮。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Sichuan, Jiangxi, Fujian.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西、貴州、四川、江西、福建。

photos.en: Pendulous greyish-white racemes on the woody climber.
photos.zh: 木質藤上的下垂灰白色總狀花序。

photos.en: Open greyish-white flower, with a long keel.
photos.zh: 開放的灰白色花，龍骨瓣長。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Shrub or small tree; stem thick and more or less succulent
facts.zh: 灌木或小喬木；莖粗而略肉質
花期 4 月至 12 月。果期 7 月至 12 月。
沙質及岩石海岸。

items.en: Shrub or small tree. Stem thick and more or less succulent.
items.zh: 灌木或小喬木。莖粗而略肉質。

items.en: Crowded towards the branch tips, obovate-oblong to spathulate, 10–22 × 4–8 cm. Margin entire.
items.zh: 聚生於枝端，倒卵狀長圓形至匙形，10–22 × 4–8 厘米。全緣。

items.en: Usually white, 20–22 mm. The five lobes spread as a half-split fan.
items.zh: 通常白色，長 20–22 毫米。五裂片開展成半邊扇形。

items.en: Ovoid or globose, 8–12 mm, crowned with the enlarged calyx lobes.
items.zh: 卵形或球形，直徑 8–12 毫米，頂端冠以增大的萼裂片。

ecology.en: Southern China to Japan, the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia and Australia.
ecology.zh: 華南至日本、菲律賓、馬來西亞、印度尼西亞及澳洲。

photos.en: Thick stem and crowded leaf tips.
White fruits with the fan flowers.

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Evergreen tree, 5–15 m; bark dark grey
facts.zh: 常綠喬木，高 5–15 米；樹皮深灰色
花期 3 月至 5 月。果期 9 月至 10 月。
低地森林。

items.en: Evergreen tree, 5–15 m. Bark dark grey.
items.zh: 常綠喬木，高 5–15 米。樹皮深灰色。

items.en: Elliptic to obovate, 5–10 × 2–5 cm. Lateral veins 15–20 on each side, slender and subparallel.
items.zh: 橢圓形至倒卵形，5–10 × 2–5 厘米。側脈每邊 15–20 條，纖細而近平行。

items.en: Yellowish green. Calyx shallowly campanulate, with 5 lobes. Petals 10, scale-like. Stamens 10.
items.zh: 黃綠色。萼筒淺鐘形，裂片 5。花瓣 10，鱗片狀。雄蕊 10。

items.en: Capsule obovoid, 2–3 × 2 cm. Seed dark brown, with a tail-shaped appendage about 2 cm.
items.zh: 蒴果倒卵形，2–3 × 2 厘米。種子深褐色，具長約 2 厘米的尾狀附屬物。

photos.en: Leaf with many subparallel lateral veins.
photos.zh: 葉具多條近平行的側脈。

photos.en: Yellowish-green flower with five calyx lobes.
Seed hanging with its tail-shaped appendage.
photos.zh: 種子連尾狀附屬物懸垂。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Tree, up to 30 m; all parts strongly camphor-scented
facts.zh: 喬木，高可達 30 米；全株有濃烈樟腦氣味
花期 4 月至 5 月。果期 8 月至 11 月。
村落附近的林中。亦有栽培。

items.en: Tree, up to 30 m tall. All parts strongly camphor-scented.
items.zh: 喬木，高可達 30 米。全株有濃烈樟腦氣味。

items.en: Alternate. Petiole slender, 2–3 cm, glabrous. Blade ovate-elliptic, 6–12 × 2.5–5.5 cm, base broadly cuneate to rounded, apex acute, margin entire, subleathery. Triplinerved, with domatia in the axils of the secondary and tertiary veins.
items.zh: 互生。葉柄細，2–3 厘米，無毛。葉片卵狀橢圓形，6–12 × 2.5–5.5 厘米，基部闊楔形至圓形，先端急尖，全緣，近革質。離基三出脈，二級脈與三級脈腋內有腺窩。

items.en: Yellowish white, ca. 3 mm. Panicles or cymes axillary, 3.5–7 cm. Stamens 9, filaments pubescent.
items.zh: 黃白色，約 3 毫米。圓錐花序或聚傘花序腋生，3.5–7 厘米。雄蕊 9，花絲被毛。

items.en: Ovoid or subglobose, 6–8 mm in diam., purplish black when mature.
items.zh: 卵形或近球形，直徑 6–8 毫米，成熟時紫黑色。

ecology.zh: 村落附近的林中。亦有栽培。

ecology.en: Native. Common in Hong Kong, and also widely cultivated.
ecology.zh: 原生。香港常見，亦廣泛栽培。

ecology.en: Widely distributed in south to southwest China; Vietnam, Korea and Japan.
ecology.zh: 中國南至西南廣泛分布；越南、韓國及日本。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Shrub or tree, 1–10 m; bark yellowish white
facts.zh: 灌木或喬木，高 1–10 米；樹皮黃白色
花期 4 月至 5 月。果期 6 月。
灌叢或次生林。

items.en: Shrubs or trees, 1–10 m tall. Bark yellowish white, glabrous.
items.zh: 灌木或喬木，高 1–10 米。樹皮黃白色，無毛。

items.en: Petiole 2–5 mm. Blade elliptic, narrow-elliptic, ovate-oblong or rarely subovate, 3–11 × 1.5–4 cm. Base cuneate, rarely rounded. Apex acute, shortly acuminate or slightly obtuse. Lateral veins slightly obvious on both surfaces.
items.zh: 葉柄 2–5 毫米。葉片橢圓形、狹橢圓形、卵狀長圓形，稀近卵形，3–11 × 1.5–4 厘米。基部楔形，稀圓形。先端急尖、短漸尖或稍鈍。側脈兩面稍明顯。

items.en: Red, ca. 1 cm in diam. Cymes axillary or extra-axillary, 1–5-flowered. Stamens usually united into 3 bundles, 4–8 mm. Glands 3, alternate with the staminal bundles, conic, 2–3 mm.
items.zh: 紅色，直徑約 1 厘米。聚傘花序腋生或腋外生，有花 1–5 朵。雄蕊通常合生為 3 束，長 4–8 毫米。腺體 3，與雄蕊束互生，圓錐狀，2–3 毫米。

items.en: Elliptic, 8–12 mm, with a persistent calyx. Seeds 6 mm, winged on one side.
items.zh: 橢圓形，8–12 毫米，具宿存萼。種子 6 毫米，一側有翅。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Guangxi and southern Yunnan; Indochina, Thailand, Myanmar, the Philippines and Indonesia.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西及雲南南部；中南半島、泰國、緬甸、菲律賓及印度尼西亞。

photos.en: Elliptic leaves on a short petiole.

photos.zh: 紅色花，直徑約 1 厘米。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 常綠喬木，高可達 40 米
花期 4 月至 5 月。果期 8 月至 10 月。

facts.en: Lowland forests and streamsides. Often cultivated.
facts.zh: 低地森林及溪邊。常有栽培。

items.en: Evergreen tree, up to 40 m. Branchlets glabrous.
items.zh: 常綠喬木，高可達 40 米。小枝無毛。

items.en: Papery, palmately 3(–5)-foliolate. Petioles 8–20 cm. Leaflets ovate, elliptic or obovate, 7–15 × 4–8 cm. Base broadly cuneate to obtuse. Apex acute or caudate-acuminate. Margin denticulate, 2–3 denticles per cm.
items.zh: 紙質，掌狀 3（–5）小葉。葉柄 8–20 厘米。小葉卵形、橢圓形或倒卵形，7–15 × 4–8 厘米。基部闊楔形至鈍。先端急尖或尾狀漸尖。邊緣具細齒，每厘米 2–3 齒。

items.en: Axillary panicles, pendent. Male panicles 8–13 cm; sepals 5. Female panicles 15–27 cm. Ovary smooth, glabrous, 3–4-locular. Styles 3–4, linear, entire.
items.zh: 腋生圓錐花序，下垂。雄花序 8–13 厘米，萼片 5。雌花序 15–27 厘米。子房平滑，無毛，3–4 室。花柱 3–4，線形，全緣。

items.en: Globose or subglobose, 6–13 mm in diam., brownish. Seeds oblong, ca. 5 mm.
items.zh: 球形或近球形，直徑 6–13 毫米，褐色。種子長圓形，約 5 毫米。

ecology.en: Lowland forests and streamsides. Often cultivated in gardens or as a roadside tree.
ecology.zh: 低地森林及溪邊。常栽培於花園或作行道樹。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Sichuan, Shaanxi, Henan, Hubei, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian and Taiwan; widely distributed in Southeast Asia, Malesia and Australia.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、四川、陝西、河南、湖北、湖南、江西、安徽、江蘇、浙江、福建及台灣；東南亞、馬來群島及澳洲廣泛分布。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Tree or shrub, 3–15 m; brown stellate tomentum
facts.zh: 喬木或灌木，高 3–15 米；被褐色星狀絨毛
花期 7 月至 10 月。果期 11 月至 12 月。
疏林及灌叢。

items.en: Tree or shrub, 3–15 m. Branchlets, petioles and inflorescence brown-stellate-tomentose.
items.zh: 喬木或灌木，高 3–15 米。小枝、葉柄及花序被褐色星狀絨毛。

items.en: Alternate, slightly peltate. Petioles 2–15 cm. Blade ovate, ovate-triangular or rhombic, 5–15 × 3–10 cm. Base cuneate or broadly cuneate. Apex long-acuminate. Margin undulate, subentire, 2-lobed or sparsely toothed. Grey-yellow- or white-tomentose when young, glabrous in age. Veins 5, basal.
items.zh: 互生，稍盾狀。葉柄 2–15 厘米。葉片卵形、卵狀三角形或菱形，5–15 × 3–10 厘米。基部楔形或闊楔形。先端長漸尖。邊緣波狀、近全緣、2 裂或疏生齒。幼時被灰黃或白色絨毛，老時無毛。基出脈 5。

items.en: Terminal, racemose or paniculate. Male inflorescence 10–20 cm; stamens 50–60. Female inflorescence 5–25 cm. Stigma 2–3 mm, plumose.
items.zh: 頂生，總狀或圓錐狀。雄花序 10–20 厘米，雄蕊 50–60。雌花序 5–25 厘米。柱頭 2–3 毫米，羽毛狀。

items.en: Oblate, 1–1.5 cm in diam., brown-stellate-tomentose and sparsely spiny. Spines soft, 4–5 mm.
items.zh: 扁球形，直徑 1–1.5 厘米，被褐色星狀絨毛並疏生軟刺。刺柔軟，4–5 毫米。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Fujian and Taiwan; Southeast Asia.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、福建及台灣；東南亞。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 1.5–4 米
花期 12 月至 2 月。果期 10 月至 12 月。

facts.en: Sea coasts, mangroves and muddy flats.
facts.zh: 海岸、紅樹林及泥灘。

items.en: Shrub or small tree, 1.5–4 m, much branched. Branchlets terete, glabrous.
items.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 1.5–4 米，多分枝。小枝圓柱形，無毛。

items.en: Alternate. Petiole 5–10 mm. Blade obovate or elliptic, 3–10 × 2–4.5 cm, leathery, glabrous. Base cuneate. Apex rounded or emarginate. Margin entire, slightly recurved. Many minute pores on both surfaces. Lateral veins 7–11 pairs.
items.zh: 互生。葉柄 5–10 毫米。葉片倒卵形或橢圓形，3–10 × 2–4.5 厘米，革質，無毛。基部楔形。先端圓或微凹。全緣，稍反卷。兩面有許多細孔。側脈 7–11 對。

items.en: Umbels terminal, axillary or leaf-opposed, many-flowered. Flowers white. Corolla lobes ovate to lanceolate, apex acute, reflexed.
items.zh: 傘形花序頂生、腋生或與葉對生，多花。花白色。花冠裂片卵形至披針形，先端急尖，反折。

items.en: Cylindric, curved, falcate or crescent-shaped, 5–8 cm, acuminate at the apex.
items.zh: 圓柱形，彎曲，鐮狀或新月形，5–8 厘米，先端漸尖。

ecology.en: Sea coasts, mangroves and muddy flats.
Hainan, Guangdong, Fujian and Guangxi; India, Malaysia, the Philippines, Sri Lanka, Vietnam and Australia.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、福建及廣西；印度、馬來西亞、菲律賓、斯里蘭卡、越南及澳洲。

photos.zh: 白色傘形花序，裂片反折。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 常綠喬木；幼枝被白色鱗秕
花期 10 月至 11 月。
海岸。

items.en: Evergreen tree. Branchlets white-lepidote when young.
items.zh: 常綠喬木。幼枝被白色鱗秕。

items.en: Petioles 1–2 cm. Leaves leathery, oblong-lanceolate, elliptic or ovate, 10–20 × 5–10 cm. Base obtuse. Apex acute or obtuse. Margin entire. Densely silvery-lepidote abaxially.
items.zh: 葉柄 1–2 厘米。葉革質，長圓狀披針形、橢圓形或卵形，10–20 × 5–10 厘米。基部鈍。先端急尖或鈍。全緣。背面密被銀色鱗秕。

items.en: Panicles axillary, many-flowered. Flowers red-brown. Calyx campanulate, 4–6 mm.
items.zh: 圓錐花序腋生，多花。花紅褐色。萼鐘形，4–6 毫米。

items.en: Ripe carpels woody, yellow-brown, nut-like, ovoid, ca. 6 × 3.5 cm, with a strong, almost winged keel along the outer edge.
items.zh: 成熟心皮木質，黃褐色，堅果狀，卵形，約 6 × 3.5 厘米，外緣有一條近翅狀的強龍骨。

ecology.en: Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan and Taiwan; Japan, the Philippines, Southeast Asia, East Africa and Australia.
ecology.zh: 廣東、廣西、海南及台灣；日本、菲律賓、東南亞、東非及澳洲。

photos.en: Woody fruit with a keeled outer edge.

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 常綠喬木，高 2–5 米
花果期 1 月至 9 月。

facts.en: Littoral muddy swamps and mangrove forests.
facts.zh: 海岸泥沼及紅樹林。

items.en: Evergreen tree, 2–5 m. Branchlets stout, glabrous.
items.zh: 常綠喬木，高 2–5 米。小枝粗，無毛。

items.en: Alternate, papery to subleathery. Petioles stout, 1.5–3 cm, with 2 glands at the apex. Blade elliptic or broad-elliptic, 4.5–10 × 3–5 cm, glabrous. Base obtuse or broadly cuneate. Apex acute, the tip blunt. Margin entire or more or less crenulate.
items.zh: 互生，紙質至近革質。葉柄粗，1.5–3 厘米，先端有腺體 2。葉片橢圓形或闊橢圓形，4.5–10 × 3–5 厘米，無毛。基部鈍或闊楔形。先端急尖，尖端鈍。全緣或多少具圓齒。

items.en: Racemes axillary. Male racemes 3–4.5 cm. Male flowers with 3 sepals and 3 stamens, the stamens usually exceeding the sepals.
items.zh: 總狀花序腋生。雄花序 3–4.5 厘米。雄花萼片 3，雄蕊 3，雄蕊通常長於萼片。

items.en: Globose, 7–8 × ca. 10 mm, trisulcate.
items.zh: 球形，7–8 × 約 10 毫米，具 3 溝。

ecology.en: Littoral muddy swamps and mangrove forests.
Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi and Taiwan; the Philippines, Vietnam, Cambodia, Thailand, India, Sri Lanka, Australia and the Pacific Islands.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西及台灣；菲律賓、越南、柬埔寨、泰國、印度、斯里蘭卡、澳洲及太平洋島嶼。

photos.en: Elliptic leaves on a stout petiole.

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Shrub or small tree, 1–4 m, with aerial roots
facts.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 1–4 米，具氣根
花期 5 月至 8 月。果期 1 月至 10 月。

facts.en: Sandy beaches. Also cultivated in gardens.
facts.zh: 沙灘。亦栽培於花園。

items.en: Shrub or small tree, 1–4 m. Stem branched, with aerial roots.
items.zh: 灌木或小喬木，高 1–4 米。莖分枝，具氣根。

items.en: Aggregated at the stem tip, leathery, loriform, usually more than 1 m × 2–5 cm. Margin and the abaxial midrib with strong upward spines. Apex long-caudate.
items.zh: 聚生於莖頂，革質，帶形，通常長逾 1 米、寬 2–5 厘米。邊緣及背面中脈有向上的硬刺。先端長尾狀。

items.en: Male inflorescence of several spikes, 4–8 cm. Female inflorescence terminal, globular.
items.zh: 雄花序由數個長 4–8 厘米的穗狀花序組成。雌花序頂生，球形。

items.en: Pendent, red, yellow to orange, of 40–80 drupes. Drupe obconical, ca. 4 cm, truncate, angular.
items.zh: 下垂，紅色、黃色至橙色，由 40–80 枚核果組成。核果倒圓錐形，約 4 厘米，截形，有棱。

ecology.en: Sandy beaches, or cultivated in gardens.
Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Fujian and Taiwan; tropical Asia to Australia.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、福建及台灣；熱帶亞洲至澳洲。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.en: Woody liana, to 10 m or longer
facts.zh: 木質藤本，長可達 10 米或更長
花期 2 月至 6 月。

facts.en: Sunny edges of forests and thickets.
facts.zh: 林緣向陽處及灌叢。

items.en: Woody liana, to 10 m or longer. Stems brownish, lenticellate. Young branchlets pubescent, glabrous when older.
items.zh: 木質藤本，長可達 10 米或更長。莖褐色，具皮孔。幼枝被毛，老時無毛。

items.en: Petiole 3–12 mm. Blade ovate to obovate or narrowly elliptic, 2–10 × 1–4.5 cm, papery, glabrous or sparsely pubescent abaxially.
items.zh: 葉柄 3–12 毫米。葉片卵形至倒卵形或狹橢圓形，2–10 × 1–4.5 厘米，紙質，無毛或背面疏被毛。

items.en: Cymes paniculate, terminal and axillary. Sepals narrowly oblong, 2–5 mm, spreading or reflexed. Corolla white; tube dilated at the middle, 5–10 mm; lobes obovate, as long as the tube. Stamens included.
items.zh: 聚傘花序排列成圓錐狀，頂生及腋生。萼片狹長圓形，2–5 毫米，開展或反折。花冠白色；冠筒中部膨大，5–10 毫米；裂片倒卵形，與冠筒等長。雄蕊內藏。

items.en: Linear, 10–25 cm × 3–10 mm. Seeds oblong, 1.5–2 cm, coma 1.5–4 cm.
items.zh: 線形，10–25 厘米 × 3–10 毫米。種子長圓形，1.5–2 厘米，種纓 1.5–4 厘米。

ecology.en: Sunny edges of forests and thickets.
East, central, south and southwest China, Shanxi, Shaanxi and Xizang; Japan and Vietnam.
ecology.zh: 中國東、中、南及西南，山西、陝西及西藏；日本及越南。

photos.en: Ovate to elliptic leaves, lower surface.
photos.zh: 卵形至橢圓形葉的背面。

reference.authors: Hong Kong Herbarium & South China Botanical Garden (Eds.).
reference.title: Flora of Hong Kong

facts.zh: 常綠無刺灌木，高 1–3 米
花期 4 月至 8 月。果期 5 月至 12 月。
山溝及山坡灌叢。

items.en: Evergreen, unarmed shrub, 1–3 m tall, glabrous throughout, or young shoots pulverulent.
items.zh: 常綠無刺灌木，高 1–3 米，全株無毛，或幼枝被粉狀毛。

items.en: Opposite, or rarely in whorls of 3, subleathery. Petioles 2–4 mm. Blade elliptic, oblong-elliptic or oblong-lanceolate, 3–10 × 1–4.5 cm. Base cuneate to broadly cuneate. Apex acute or acuminate. Lateral veins 7–12 on each side. Stipules ca. 1 cm, united into a sheath.
items.zh: 對生，稀 3 葉輪生，近革質。葉柄 2–4 毫米。葉片橢圓形、長圓狀橢圓形或長圓狀披針形，3–10 × 1–4.5 厘米。基部楔形至闊楔形。先端急尖或漸尖。側脈每邊 7–12 條。托葉約 1 厘米，合生成鞘。

items.en: Terminal, solitary. Calyx tube obconical, 8–20 mm, with 5–6 sharp ribs; limb usually 6-lobed. Corolla salverform; tube cylindric, 2.5–4 cm, green; limb 5–6 cm in diam., usually 6-lobed, the lobes white. Anthers linear, 1.2–1.6 cm, exserted.
items.zh: 頂生，單生。萼筒倒圓錐形，8–20 毫米，具 5–6 條銳棱；萼檐通常 6 裂。花冠高腳碟狀；冠筒圓柱形，2.5–4 厘米，綠色；檐部直徑 5–6 厘米，通常 6 裂，裂片白色。花藥線形，1.2–1.6 厘米，伸出。

items.en: Ellipsoidal, 2.5–3 cm, crowned by the long persistent calyx lobes, and marked outside by as many raised ribs.
items.zh: 橢圓形，2.5–3 厘米，頂端有宿存的長萼裂片，外面有同樣數目的隆起棱。

ecology.en: Hainan, Guangdong, Guangxi, Guizhou, Yunnan, Sichuan, Hunan, Jiangxi, Anhui, Shandong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian and Taiwan; Japan, Indochina, and cultivated elsewhere.
ecology.zh: 海南、廣東、廣西、貴州、雲南、四川、湖南、江西、安徽、山東、江蘇、浙江、福建及台灣；日本、中南半島，其他地方有栽培。

photos.en: Ellipsoidal fruit with persistent calyx lobes.
photos.zh: 橢圓形果，具宿存萼裂片。
